title: Is CATIA Free for Students? CATIA Student Price, Licence and Free Options (2026)
summary: No: CATIA for Students costs USD 60/EUR 60 a year, Windows only, and the free V5 Student Edition is withdrawn. Free routes, licence rules and whether to buy.
body_markdown:
## Is CATIA free for students?


**No, not as a personal download.** The official student route is **3DEXPERIENCE CATIA for Students** at **USD 60 / EUR 60 for one year** , Windows only. The old free CATIA V5 Student Edition has been withdrawn. You can use CATIA without paying through your college's lab licence, and Dassault's student offer includes three certifications.


Everything below was checked on Dassault Systèmes' pages on **17 November 2026** . CATIA matters to Indian mechanical and automotive students because many automotive and aerospace OEMs and their design suppliers use it for body, interior and sheet metal design.


## What happened to the free CATIA V5 Student Edition?


It is gone. Dassault's[CATIA V5 student page](https://www.3ds.com/edu/education/students/solutions/catia-v5) now says: "CATIA V5 Student Edition is no longer available for students online" and points students to the 3DEXPERIENCE version. Any website still offering a "free CATIA V5 student download" is not an official Dassault source. Cracked copies are illegal and a common way malware gets onto student laptops.


## What do you get with CATIA for Students?


The[CATIA for Students page](https://www.3ds.com/edu/education/students/solutions/catia-3dx) lists the offer (shown as "CATIA Mechanical for Students"):


Item What the offer includes (17 Nov 2026)


Price **USD 60 / EUR 60** , excluding local VAT, one-time payment


Licence term **1 year** , no automatic commitment ("No Engagement")


Apps Part Design, Assembly Design, Drafting, Generative Modeling, Class-A Surface Design and others


Certifications 3 included: 3D Innovator, Mechanical Designer (hands-on) and Collaborative Business & Industry Innovator, each valued at USD 50 / EUR 50


Extras Online learning content and the student community


Operating system Windows 10 and 11, installed on your own machine


The three certifications alone are listed at USD 150 of value, so the offer is mainly worth it if you plan to take them.

## Can Indian students buy CATIA for Students?


**Yes.** India is on the list of countries where the student store is available, and the store FAQ says prices are shown in **Indian rupees** in the cart (the page itself shows only USD and EUR). Dassault verifies you automatically against education data sources; if that fails you may be asked to upload a student ID. Two eligibility rules catch people out:


- You must be **18 or older** to buy.
- "Participants enrolled in professional training programs are not eligible", so it is meant for students at a school, college or university.


## What are the CATIA student licence rules?


- **Personal learning only:** "This offer is for personal use only, not for classroom", and it excludes "any direct or indirect industrial, commercial and/or business purposes".
- **No renewal:** the store FAQ calls student offers "non-renewable yearly subscriptions". Plan your year of use around a project or a certification.
- **Windows only, no VM, no Mac:** CATIA for Students "requires installation on your Windows machine, supported Windows 10 & 11… it will not work on a virtual machine and on Mac OS."


The no-VM rule matters for Mac users: unlike SOLIDWORKS, you cannot run CATIA for Students in Parallels. You need a Windows laptop or your college lab. Our[laptop guide for engineering students](https://resources.skill-lync.com/articles/best-laptop-for-engineering-students-india/) lists what CATIA and other CAD tools need.
